name: llama.cpp GBNF grammars
author: ggml-org
one_liner: llama.cpp can restrict a local model's output to a formal grammar (GBNF), for example valid JSON or a chess move list.

loop.proposes: the next token from a local model run by llama.cpp
loop.judged_by: the GBNF grammar, passed with --grammar-file or --grammar, checked in code at each step
loop.steers: only tokens that keep the text inside the grammar can be sampled

not_proved: The grammar guarantees syntax only. A chess-format grammar will accept an illegal or silly move as long as it is written in the right notation.
